arguments.description: Curl this same tan armored turtle-rabbit completely into a compact round shell ball for rolling. Tuck the head, feet and tail inside; fold the long ears flat against the shell. A few broad dark shell seams on a rounded tan armored sphere, no legs running or standing. Keep the same exact pixel-art palette, one-pixel black outline and simple flat material shading. One ball, transparent background, native 48x35 canvas, centered around x24, grounded at y34, approximately 19 pixels wide and 19 pixels high. No motion trails, glow or extra objects.
